newsitem.title: DUBAI: Jordan's King Hussein in Saudi for pilgrimage.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's King Hussein in Saudi for pilgrimage.

text.p: King Hussein of Jordan arrived in Saudi Arabia on Thursday for a pilgrimage to Mecca, Saudi state television reported.
A Jordanian palace official said earlier in the day that the Jordanian leader was also expected to meet with King Fahd.
The two leaders put aside six years of bitterness last year when King Fahd met King Hussein for talks on Middle East peace efforts.

Jordan's ties with its large oil-rich neighbour were strained in 1990 when King Hussein refused to join Saudi Arabia and other Arab and Western countries in a military coalition to drive Iraqi occupation troops from Kuwait.
The king, whose great-grandfather was ruler of Mecca until its capture by King Fahd's father King Abdul-Aziz in 1924, will perform the minor pilgrimage of Umra.
